nodes.title: Settings > Channels is the template manager and the WhatsApp readiness rail: the number (connected from the WhatsApp Cloud API integration; the verify token is shown once), what still waits before WhatsApp can send with how long (Meta's webhook handshake, each template in review, overdue past 24 h, rules whose template is not approved, sending not switched on), the templates (draft with each value's source and Meta's sample, submit, check reviews), and follow-ups after calls. channel.readiness is the read behind the rail, for the campaign launch card too
nodes.rationale: Builder brief step 3 (approval status with timers on the readiness rail). The UI keys value sources with '__' for '.' so the UI contract does not read them as tool names. The dev server uses an in-process fake Graph API whose review approves a template on the next status check (DEV ONLY), so the page works without a Meta account.
nodes.reverse_if: The campaign launch card shows template readiness itself (then the rail here is a summary), or buyers need the templates beside the agent rather than in Settings.
